response.overview: A man who loves unchanging beauty and a woman who yearns for living emotion. Though they share the same space, they ultimately fail to understand each other, and the woman gradually transforms from a 'beloved' into a 'preserved object.'  Even her desperate attempt to escape becomes, in the man's eyes, another beautiful moment, and finally the woman asks:  "Is this your love?"  This work portrays obsession and objectification perpetrated under the name of love, and the end of a relationship that crumbles as a result.
response.title: Is This How You Love
